ctx.x: Lyricanz, and he brought one for me to try and show me how to finger it and the whole thing, because I might dig, like, blowing on it. And I realized that it might be a lot of fun, after testing for about a half a second, but I also realized that it would take a great deal of time for me to begin to cope with it. So I said -- I asked him to go into the booth and take over.
